title: Founder Jam Config
description: Optional Claude Code convenience file. It mirrors the FOUNDER JAM HANDOFF block defined in the founder-setup skill. claude.ai and Claude desktop users paste the handoff block instead and need no file.

path.description: The founder's path, chosen with their sherpa during Focus

problem_statement.description: The core problem your startup solves

team_size.description: Number of people on the team

traction.description: Current traction: users, revenue, waitlist, LOIs, etc.

mode.description: empty = not asked yet (skills ask once whether a sherpa is present); solo = no challenge prompts; with-sherpa = skills add challenge questions the sherpa or founder can ask

icp_segment.description: Selected beachhead ICP segment (set by icp-definer)

top_pains.description: The 1-2 pains the beachhead segment feels most (set by icp-definer)

channels_selected.description: Primary distribution channels (set by icp-definer or growth-builder)

lead_magnet.description: Selected lead magnet type and title (set by offer-designer)

business_type.description: Business model type for tailored recommendations

outbound_system.description: One-line summary of the founder-led outbound system: channels, cadence, CTA, tier (set by outbound-composer)

published_pages.description: Live pages published during or after the workshop (set by page-launcher). In the handoff block this is a comma-separated list of purpose=url pairs.
